modeSelect.aiHint: View the result produced by the AI Director
editor.title: 🎬 Editor
editor.empty.title: Upload a video to start editing
editor.addVideo.compositeNote: Only the primary video is auto-rendered for now. Composite rendering is a follow-up.
editor.toolbar.title: Tools
editor.toolbar.caption: Caption
editor.toolbar.aiEdit.title: AI Edit
editor.toolbar.aiEdit.hint: Describe the edit in natural language — AI converts it into actions and adds them to the timeline.
editor.toolbar.aiEdit.placeholder: e.g. Keep only the first 5 seconds and add a 'Hello' caption
editor.autoCaption.empty: No speech recognized (Whisper unavailable or silent)
editor.highlights.title: Extract Highlights
editor.highlights.hint: Claude analyzes the transcript and suggests 15–60s key ranges for short-form clips.
editor.highlights.applied: Highlight range applied to the timeline
editor.cutSuggest.title: Silence/Filler Cut Suggestions
editor.cutSuggest.hint: Finds silences (gaps ≥ 1.5s) and filler words (음, 어, uh, um, ...) via local analysis.
editor.narration.title: Generate Narration
editor.narration.hint: Creates narration with macOS local TTS (say) and adds it to the audio track. Default voice: Yuna.
editor.narration.done: Narration added to the audio track
editor.timeline.title: Timeline
editor.inspector.title: Properties
editor.inspector.placeholder: Select an action to view its properties
editor.empty: No actions yet. Pick a tool to start editing.
editor.aiIntent: Describe the edit you want in natural language (e.g. 1-minute highlight reel)
editor.preview.title: Preview
editor.preview.empty: Your video will appear here once loaded
editor.preview.streamNote: Source preview stream is a follow-up — only rendered output is shown for now
editor.preview.liveNote: Edits are reflected instantly. Click 'Render' for final output.
editor.source.title: Source Video
editor.fab.title: Ask MyCrew
editor.fab.hint: Describe the edit you want — AI will convert it into actions.
editor.action.bgmUploadHint: Click or drag an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC · up to 100MB)
editor.action.errEndAfterStart: End must be greater than start
editor.action.errFactorRange: Speed factor must be between 0.25 and 4.0
editor.help.cut.desc: Cut — split one clip into two at a given timestamp
editor.help.cut.usage: e.g. Time 5000 → split at 5s into (1) head and (2) tail
editor.help.trim.desc: Trim — keep only the start–end range, discard the rest
editor.help.trim.usage: e.g. Start 2000, End 8000 → keep the 2s–8s 6-second window
editor.help.reframe.desc: Reframe — change aspect ratio and crop around a focal point
editor.help.reframe.usage: e.g. 9:16 → vertical shorts. Adjust Focal X/Y to recenter
editor.help.caption.desc: Caption — overlay text on a time range
editor.help.caption.usage: e.g. Start 0, End 3000, Text 'Hello' → bottom caption for the first 3s
editor.help.bgm.desc: BGM — mix background music into the video audio
editor.help.bgm.usage: Upload an audio file to auto-fill the path. Volume 0~1 controls loudness
editor.help.transition.desc: Transition — smoothly transition between two clips
editor.help.transition.usage: e.g. From clip(1) → To clip(2), Kind fade, Duration 500ms → 0.5s fade
editor.help.opacity.usage: e.g. From 1.0, To 0.5 → fade from opaque to half-transparent
editor.help.transform.desc: Transform — scale, rotate, and move clip
editor.help.transform.usage: e.g. Scale 1.5 (1.5x zoom), Rotate 45 (45° rotation), Translate X/Y to reposition
editor.help.generate.desc: AI Generate — produce image/video/audio from a prompt and insert into the timeline
editor.help.generate.usage: May incur cost. Requires MYMOVIE_GENERATE_*_KEY env vars. Without them only the scaffold action is recorded.
editor.inspector.multiCount: {n} clips selected. Only shared properties can be batch-edited.
editor.inspector.multiHint: Select a single clip to show the keyframe panel.
editor.inspector.noForm: No inspector form is available for this action type yet.
editor.timeline.selection: Selected clips: {n} · Delete=normal delete, Shift+Delete=ripple delete
editor.track.empty: Load a video to display the timeline
editor.track.bgmEmpty: BGM track (shown when music is added)
editor.track.textEmpty: Caption track (shown when captions are added)
editor.track.imageEmpty: Image overlay track (shown when images are added)
editor.track.help: Click the ruler to move the playhead · Drag block edges to trim · Drag the body to move (snap) · Drag empty area to multi-select · Yellow line = cut point
editor.kf.title: Keyframes
editor.kf.help: + button or double-click the track → add a keyframe at the current playhead
